name: Analytical Approximation of Single Scattering Radiance
aliases: First-Order Taylor Expansion of Incident Radiance
definition: An efficient analytical approximation for computing in-scattered radiance $J_{ss}$ that avoids repeated ray tracing by decomposing the phase function and incident radiance into direction-independent terms pre-computed per voxel.
summary: This method approximates single scattering radiance using low-order expansions to pre-compute direction-independent terms, offering a significantly more efficient alternative to Monte Carlo ray tracing for differentiable rendering.
